agent.result_text:
Backing now works the new way, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The only file I changed is `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. The server and stored data needed no change, because each claim already keeps its frozen figure from when it was settled.

A person's backing is now their patrons' frozen settled figures added up, counting only claims that are SETTLED and dated within the 90 days up to and including the sheet's today. With none it shows 0.00.

The 90 days count today itself, so the earliest date included is today minus 89 days. The test depends on this: with today 2026-03-10, a claim dated 2025-12-11 counts and one dated 2025-12-01 doesn't.

As the test expects, a claim that is later voided drops out of backing, and changing a rate after settling doesn't change the figure.

I also updated the description comment in that file to match the new rule.
